name: Roam Research
tagline: Roam Research is a note-taking tool built around bidirectional linking and outliner-style writing, designed to mirror how the mind associatively connects ideas. Every page can reference any other, building a dense knowledge graph that surfaces unexpected connections over time. Knowledge workers and writers use Roam as a 'second brain' for capturing and connecting ideas over years of continuous use.
